label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y a los extremos del mishkán, mar, hizo seis tablas.
spanish: Y a los dos extremos del tabernáculo, hacia el mar, hizo seis tablas.
grammarChanges: Translated the common noun mishkán (H4908) as tabernáculo instead of leaving it untranslated.
Restored the directional suffix on H3220: rendered as hacia el mar (toward the sea) instead of the bare noun mar.
Marked the feminine dual construct (H3411) explicitly as los dos extremos instead of the unmarked plural extremos.
readerNote: Dual construct rendered as 'los dos extremos' to mark the Hebrew dual that plain 'extremos' did not show.
